deliveryMethod: Original app pending alarm dispatched by Android after controlled wall-clock advance; no broadcast/notification injected by harness
scope: Original APK alarm delivered into Android System UI after advancing the disposable device wall clock beyond the next inexact task-alarm window. No notification or app broadcast injected. Clock restored; Android notification permission revoked; explicit app opt-out cancelled pending alarms. This does not establish natural-clock latency, reboot/Doze or OEM-specific behavior.
